from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = Image.open('input_files/input-01.png').convert('L')
a = np.array(im)
dark = a < 128

def proj(name, x0,y0,x1,y1):
    reg = dark[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    rows = reg.sum(axis=1)
    cols = reg.sum(axis=0)
    print(f'--- {name} rows (y): strong horiz lines')
    for i,v in enumerate(rows):
        if v > (x1-x0)*0.25:
            print(' y=',y0+i,' count=',v)
    print(f'--- {name} cols (x): strong vert lines')
    for i,v in enumerate(cols):
        if v > (y1-y0)*0.25:
            print(' x=',x0+i,' count=',v)

# top-left view region (plate only, avoid dims)
proj('A-plate', 640, 280, 1060, 420)
EOF

im = Image.open('input_files/input-01.png').convert('L')

print('== dim 19 line at x=621: y-runs')

    if not v and s is not None: runs.append((240+s,240+i-1)); s=None

print('== scan for dim lines wider ranges')
for xr,(y0,y1),tag in [ (range(640,720),(280,400),'11-dim'),
                        (range(1030,1110),(280,430),'20-dim') ]:
    best=[]
    for x in xr:
        c = dark[y0:y1, x].sum()
        if c>30: best.append((x,int(c)))
    print(tag, best)
EOF

  (command "_.BOX" (list 0 -15 0) (list 80 15 15))

  (setq s2 (entlast))
  (command "_.PLINE" (list 0 12 0) (list 0 15 0) (list 3 15 0) "_C")
  (setq p1 (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" p1 "" 15)
  (setq w1 (entlast))
  (command "_.PLINE" (list 0 -12 0) (list 0 -15 0) (list 3 -15 0) "_C")
  (setq p2 (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" p2 "" 15)
  (setq w2 (entlast))
  (command "_.PLINE" (list 80 10 0) (list 80 15 0) (list 75 15 0) "_C")
  (setq p3 (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" p3 "" 15)
  (setq w3 (entlast))
  (command "_.PLINE" (list 80 -10 0) (list 80 -15 0) (list 75 -15 0) "_C")
  (setq p4 (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" p4 "" 15)
  (setq w4 (entlast))
  (command "_.CYLINDER" (list 30 9.5 0) 1.7 15)
  (setq h1 (entlast))
  (command "_.CYLINDER" (list 30 -9.5 0) 1.7 15)
  (setq h2 (entlast))
  (command "_.CYLINDER" (list 45 9.5 0) 1.7 15)
  (setq h3 (entlast))
  (command "_.CYLINDER" (list 45 -9.5 0) 1.7 15)
  (setq h4 (entlast))
  (command "_.SUBTRACT" base "" c1 s1 s2 w1 w2 w3 w4 h1 h2 h3 h4 "")
  (setq solids (ssget "_X" (list (cons 0 "3DSOLID"))))
  (princ (strcat "\nSOLIDS AFTER STAGE1: " (itoa (sslength solids))))
  (command "_.MASSPROP" (ssname solids 0) "")
  (princ "\nSTAGE1 DONE\n")
)
